title_2.jcr:title: 4K Multi-Input / Multi-Output De-Interlacer and Scaler LSI with Embedded Memory

textwithimage_1.text:
A high-performance video processing solution designed for multi-stream 4K pipelines, enabling scaling, de-interlacing, overlay, and advanced display control in a single chip.

The IP00C335 from i-Chips is a multi-functional image processing LSI that integrates scaling, de-interlacing, and multi-window video processing with embedded frame memory. It is designed to process up to four independent 4K60 video streams in real time, enabling compact system architectures for advanced display, broadcast, and ProAV applications.

text_1.text:
The i-Chips IP00C335 is a high-performance 4K video processing LSI designed for systems that require multi-input handling, flexible display composition, and real-time image processing.

By integrating scaling, de-interlacing, overlay, and memory into a single device, the IP00C335 enables designers to build compact and efficient video processing architectures. The device can process up to four 4K60 inputs simultaneously and generate dual 4K outputs, making it ideal for applications such as video walls, broadcast multi-viewers, and advanced display systems.

Its internal architecture includes multiple independent scaler and de-interlacer engines, enabling simultaneous processing of multiple video streams with low latency and high image quality.

• Multi-Stream 4K Processing: Process up to four independent 4K60 video streams in a single device for multi-display and multi-window systems
  • Integrated Scaling and De-Interlacing: Includes 8 scaler engines and 4 de-interlacer cores for high-speed image processing at 333 MHz
  • Embedded Frame Memory: Built-in LPDDR3 memory eliminates the need for external frame memory, simplifying system design
  • Advanced Display Functions: Supports PiP and PoP overlay, independent zoom and shrink, and flexible image composition
  • HDR Support: Supports PQ and Hybrid Log-Gamma (HLG) for modern HDR display applications

• Up to 4 × 4K60 input streams
  • Dual 4K60 output channels
  • Supports higher input formats including 4K120 and 8K60 (YUV420)

• 8-channel scaler architecture
  • 4-channel motion-adaptive de-interlacer
  • Independent processing per input stream

• Picture-in-picture (PiP) and picture-over-picture (PoP)
  • Overlay and alpha blending
  • Independent zoom and shrink per input

• Frame rate conversion
  • Genlock and external synchronization
  • Tearing protection for stable display output

• PQ (HDR10) and HLG support
  • Motion-adaptive processing
  • High-quality scaling and filtering

text_1.text:
• Video Wall Controllers: Multi-input display processing and tiled display systems
  • Broadcast Multi-Viewer Systems: Simultaneous monitoring and processing of multiple video feeds
  • Professional AV Systems: Switchers, processors, and presentation systems
  • Medical and Industrial Displays: High-resolution visualization and multi-source display systems
  • UI/UX Multi-Display Interfaces: On-screen display and multi-channel interface rendering

The IP00C335 sits at the core of advanced video processing pipelines, managing multiple input sources and delivering optimized output to displays such as video walls, monitors, and UI systems.

It is particularly well suited for designs where multiple video sources must be combined, processed, and displayed in real time with high image quality and low latency.

/content/copia-teste/americas/mai/en/pro.keywords: Canon, CMOS, Image Sensor, 2M, high-speed, high resolution, high sensitivity, development kit,industrial vision,global shutter

text_1.text:
LI7070SA’s Improved NIR Sensitivity is Ideal for Security, Industrial and Medical Applications.

The Canon LI7070SA CMOS Sensor, available in RGB and Mono, offers 2M pixels with increased sensitivity in the NIR range in addition to HDR functions. Its compact 1/1.8″ design with square 4.1μm x 4.1μm pixel arrangement makes it particularly suitable for nighttime surveillance of public spaces, roads, and transportation facilities in addition to use in cameras equipped to drones or used in microscopes, which both require compact image sensors with a high sensitivity.

textwithimage_1.text:
High-Sensitivity NIR Shooting

This enables monitoring in dark environments which cannot be seen by the naked eye. The sensors can also be used in industrial applications such as inspection in dark areas and medical uses such as fluorescein angiography. The LI7070SAC has improved near-infrared sensitivity by approximately 2.4 times compared to the LI7050SAC. The LI7070SAC can capture full-HD video even in low-illumination environments measuring 0.08 lux, whereas the LI7070SAM operates at a minimum of 0.04 lux. The outstanding low illumination and NIR sensitivity of these sensors further expands their applicability.

/content/copia-teste/americas/mai/en/pro.jcr:title: Canon LI7060 HDR CMOS Sensor
/content/copia-teste/americas/mai/en/pro.jcr:description: Canon’s newly developed 2.8 MP LI7060 CMOS sensor is equipped with an HDR drive function that achieves a wide 120 dB range at low noise levels. This wide range results in a greater ability to extract usable information even where there is a substantial difference between the lightest and darkest areas of an image. Even when using the sensor during normal drive operation, the sensor can achieve a dynamic range of 75 dB.
/content/copia-teste/americas/mai/en/pro.keywords: Canon, CMOS, Image Sensor, 2.8MP, high-speed, high resolution, high sensitivity, development kit,industrial vision,global shutter

textwithimage_1.text:
High-Dynamic Range For More Usable Data

Canon’s newly developed 2.8 MP LI7060 CMOS sensor is equipped with an HDR drive function that achieves a wide 120 dB range at low noise levels. This wide range results in a greater ability to extract usable information even where there is a substantial difference between the lightest and darkest areas of an image. Even when using the sensor during normal drive operation, the sensor can achieve a dynamic range of 75 dB.

With a diagonal size of 1/2.32 inches (7.75 mm), the LI7060 features approximately 2.8 million effective pixels (1936 x 1456), a pixel size of 3.2 μm x 3.2 μm and a frame rate of 60 fps (30 fps during HDR drive operation). The sensor will be compatible with the MIPI CSI-2 interface used by consumer-oriented cameras for a wide variety of purposes.

text_1.text:
Achieving High Image Quality in Extreme Temperatures

In high temperature conditions, the increase in dark current noise adversely affects the quality of the image. The Canon LI7060 sensor is equipped with functionality that mitigates dark current due to increased temperatures, Canon’s sensor is able to maintain high image quality while operating in environments with extreme temperatures ranging from -40°C to 105°C, or -40°F to 221°F.

Canon LI7060 CMOS Sensor Expands Possibilities Across Industries

For high-dynamic range imaging and extreme temperature applications, the Canon LI7060 CMOS Sensor is appropriate for:
